_comment: Copy to dev.json and fill in. dev.json is git-ignored — never commit real keys. Recommended: point AI_BASE_URL at the deployed proxy (https://cheaptripchip-api.vercel.app) and set AI_API_KEY to the proxy's APP_TOKEN; the real OpenCode Go key lives only in the proxy's Vercel env as OPENCODE_API_KEY (see docs/ai-proxy.md). Direct, dev-only: AI_BASE_URL https://opencode.ai/inference/go with your own Go key — never ship a build with it. AI_MODELS is an optional comma-separated model pool override (empty = defaults).
